title: Excel now supports multiple values in a single cell
summary: Microsoft Excel has introduced a new feature allowing users to store multiple values (lists and arrays) within a single cell, leveraging dynamic arrays and spill functionality. This represents a significant enhancement to Excel's traditional data model where each cell typically held a single value.
problem_solved: Traditional Excel cells can only hold one value, making it difficult to work with lists or collections of data within a single cell structure.
why_valuable: This feature enables more flexible data organization, simplifies complex formulas with array operations, and brings Excel closer to modern programming paradigms with native list/array support.
